name: The Bright Building
description: A historic downtown Provo reception venue in a renovated auto dealership, offering an industrial and mid-century setting with a loft, commercial kitchen prep area, built-in lighting, audio equipment, and flexible vendor options.

items.label: Description
items.value: A historic downtown Provo reception venue in a renovated auto dealership, offering an industrial and mid-century setting with a loft, commercial kitchen prep area, built-in lighting, audio equipment, and flexible vendor options.

items.label: Packages & add-ons
items.value:
Full-day wedding rental 10am-11pm: Mon-Wed — $1,250; Thu — $1,950; Fri & Sun — $2,250; Sat — $2,450
Includes 15 wood and steel tables, 150 wooden folding chairs, wood arch, cake table, projector and large screen, speaker system, 1 wireless microphone, 2 adjustable circle chandeliers, strung market lighting, bride/groom room, kitchen prep space, loft, 6 restrooms, 3 floor easels, music/media adaptors
Early day-of setup before 10am — $150 per hour (if available)
Night-before setup — $350 (if available)
Quinceañera package 10am-2am: Mon-Wed $1,950; Thu $2,150; Fri & Sun $2,350; Sat $2,550
Non-wedding events, 6-hour block: Mon-Wed $650; Thu-Sun $850

items.label: Deposit
items.value: 50% of the venue price, non-refundable, at booking

items.label: Included items
items.value:
15 custom wood and steel tables
150 wooden folding chairs
Cake table and cake stand
Wood arch (6 ft wide, 7 ft tall)
2 adjustable circle chandeliers
Permanently hung cafe/market string lights
3 floor easels
2 chalkboard/dry-erase easels
4 cocktail tables
Bureau
Indoor plants

items.label: Setup & cleanup
items.value:
Extra cost
Self-setup and self-cleanup allowed at no charge (cleaning supplies and checklist provided)

items.label: Equipment
items.value:
Yes
Professional speaker system
1 wireless microphone
Projector and large screen
Music/media adaptors

items.label: For rent
items.value: Decor packages with setup and takedown from the in-house rental company Gloss (prices not listed)

items.label: Extras
items.value:
Loft/mezzanine
Powder room for getting ready
Spiral staircase
6 restrooms
Large garage door entrance
In-house catering and decorating services (paid)
Wedding planner referrals (Evergreen & Ivy, Soiree Productions)
Early setup — $150 per hour; night-before setup — $350

items.label: Items
items.value: 15 tables 3x8 ft; 150 wooden folding chairs; wood arch 6 ft wide x 7 ft tall; cake stand 2 ft across; 4 cocktail tables; bureau; 3 floor easels; 2 chalkboard/dry-erase easels; 2 decorative rings 6 ft across; projector and large screen; speaker system; 1 wireless microphone; 2 adjustable circle chandeliers; strung market lighting; spiral staircase; garage door; catering prep kitchen; one 220V plug

items.label: Catering
items.value:
Any vendor allowed
In-house catering available
Preferred vendor list (not required)

items.label: Kitchen / prep
items.value:
Catering prep kitchen with its own entrance
Commercial fridge
Freezer
Sink
Counter space

items.label: Alcohol
items.value:
Alcohol allowed with a licensed bartender
$200 alcohol fee

items.label: Sparklers
items.value:
Yes
Sparkler send-offs shown in the venue gallery; no written policy

items.label: Times
items.value:
Mon 10am-11pm
Tue 10am-11pm
Wed 10am-11pm
Thu 10am-11pm
Fri 10am-11pm
Sat 10am-11pm
Sun 10am-11pm

items.label: Restrictions
items.value:
No duct tape
No confetti
No glitter
Charges apply for banned items, extra cleaning or damage
Early setup only when booked and available
Night-before setup only when available

items.label: Parking
items.value:
Private lot with 45 spaces
Street parking

items.label: Notes
items.value:
Former 1940s car dealership in Provo's historic Auto Row
Weddings are booked as full days only
Hosting events since 2017

items.label: Services
items.value: setup/cleanup (fee not listed); decor packages via Gloss Design and Rentals; in-house catering
